title: feat: add Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo via Alibaba Model Studio
author: tomdacatto

gist.summary: Added paid-only qwen/qwen-image-2.1-turbo through Alibaba DashScope International (Singapore), billed per generated image; no fallback provider is configured. It supports text-to-image generation and editing with up to 10 reference images, a seed parameter, and image areas from 512×512 to 2560×2560, without a watermark. Local end-to-end tests verified 1280×720 generation and reference-image editing. Identical repeat requests returned cached results without a second charge; an oversized 4096×4096 request returned Alibaba’s range error without a charge. Alibaba’s usage.image_count counts output images, not reference images.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden studio, Polli wears a tiny painter’s beret and helps arrange reference pictures beside a glowing Qwen image canvas, with code-plants growing from prominent lime green (#ecf874) pots. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. She should be small-to-medium sized within the scene, sharing the frame with other elements — never oversized or dominating the image. Strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a warm cream and lime green (#ecf874) background.
